name: Szűr (Hungary)
description: White field with a blue stripe along the bottom rising diagonally as a wedge towards the fly, charged in the upper hoist with the municipal arms of Szűr (a blue and green shield with the monogram SR, red mantling and a scroll inscribed SZŰR).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szűr arms with mantling and scroll
